fieldTreatment.rule: Production ownership UUIDs must be replaced by Development Auth UUIDs; password hashes, sessions, refresh tokens, identities and MFA records are never copied.
Provider credentials, service-role secrets, Vault values, scheduler tokens and AI credentials are never copied.
Portfolio, broker-account relationships, transactions and owner settings may be copied only into the private Development project for acceptance testing; preserve financial values and provenance.
Retain only fields required to preserve accounting/source provenance; never treat copied broker metadata as redistributable public data.
Immutable provider/raw evidence may be retained in private Development only when required for reproducibility and provenance; do not republish or export outside the private acceptance environment.
Copied market observations remain an internal cache for acceptance testing and are not a redistribution dataset.
Retain provenance/metadata already stored canonically; external document bodies remain governed by their source rights and are not copied unless separately authorized.
No unrelated personal contact data is part of the acceptance dataset.
Existing recommendation/reference outputs may be copied to validate lineage; P3 creates no new score, recommendation or sizing output.

licensingBoundary.rightsAssumption: No broader redistribution/license right is inferred from Production access or private Development copying.
